card.name: Dose rates inside infusion tables
card.fires_on: Parts of dose numbers and rate units (comma in 40,000, mg, /min, /kg, /hour) inside infusion dosing tables, just before the infusion rate or duration continues.

modes.label: Rate units
modes.description: The unit piece of an infusion rate such as mg/min or mcg/kg/min.

modes.label: Inside dose numbers
modes.description: A comma or unit within a large dose figure in a table of units or mg per hour.

modes.label: Spacing in dose rows
modes.description: A blank space right after a rate or heading in a dosing row, before the next value.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words about duration and time spans, such as months and shortening, in the next text.
card.plain: It marks the middle of infusion rate entries in dosing tables, where the next text is a number or a time.
